mentions.name: 16x Eval
mentions.description: A desktop GUI app for evaluating prompts and models. It lets users manage prompts, contexts, and models in one place, locally on their machine, and test different combinations and use cases with a few clicks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://eval.16x.engineer/ - 16x Eval: A desktop GUI app to evaluate prompts and models

With 16x Eval, you can manage your prompts, contexts, and models in one place, locally on your machine, and test out different combinations and use cases with a few clicks.
